notes:
v4.6.90 — Less lag, no phantom re-allocation profit, live IBKR allocation

⚡ PERFORMANCE (lag/freeze)
• The bot log box now caps at 800 lines (it used to grow without limit and froze the app after a few hours of streaming).
• Cloud bots now poll every 60s (was 30s) and fetch a small log tail (250 lines, was 8000) — far less work on the UI thread, plus a more reliable 'append only new lines' diff.

💵 ALLOCATION / P&L
• Removing a bot now wipes its lifetime baseline, so re-allocating it later no longer shows the new grant as 'profit' against the old, lower baseline.
• Tools → IBKR now refreshes each bot's LIVE value + share every 30s and shows the live allocated $ total, so the numbers track each bot's growth automatically.

Note: a re-seeded bot's allocation is still % of CURRENTLY-FREE cash — if lots of cash is free it can be a larger share of the whole account. Tell me if you'd prefer % of the total account instead.

Update via the in-app banner.
